title: The Bob Mod!
description: The Bob Mod adds, you guessed it, Bob! Bob can fly around his bob castle, and his portal room to the Bob dimension. The Bob chicken is also added, and is a brand new boss to fight!
body:
# Whats in the mod, anyway?
> Bob
-  Bob flies around randomly, and when killed, drops bob's brains
> Bob Portal Room
- The Bob Portal Room spawns in the bob biome and lets you access the Bob dimension.
> Bob Chicken
- The Bob Chicken is a new boss, and has a LOT lot of health.
> Bob Biome
- The Bob Biome is a biome that is covered in waxed weathered cut copper stairs, and has 3 layers of diamond blocks underneath.
> Bob Dimension
- The Bob Dimension is covered with bob blocks. That's it.
> Taco
- The Taco has a nutrition value of 9 and a saturation of 1.1.
> Bucket of Milk, but beter
- The Bucket of milk, but better is a placeable milk bucket. Does not rid effects, however.
> Bobcatsle
- The Bobcaltle is a randomly spawning castle. Not much to it.

**And much more!**




# If you have any suggestions, comment on this video!
